title: Linfox Transport Australia Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of FCL Interstate Transport Services Pty Ltd
targets: FCL Interstate Transport Services Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commence
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced that it would not oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Summary: Australia's largest privately owned transport company, Linfox, proposed to acquire rail freight forwarder FCL.
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant markets in this matter were considered to be: - the market for rail freight forwarding between the eastern states and Perth; and - the market for freight forwarding between the eastern states.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC noted that the proposed acquisition would lead to increased market concentration in the relevant markets, but did not consider that this would lead to a substantial lessening of competition. In the east-west market, the ACCC noted that the presence of a number of different rail freight forwarders, including the combined Toll/Patrick entity, would be likely to provide a competitive constraint on the merged entity post merger. In the north-south market, the ACCC concluded that the presence of many different rail, road and sea freight forwarders, including the combined Toll/Patrick entity, would be likely to have the effect of providing a competitive constrain on the merged entity.
